name: RayGauss
definition: A ray-traced variant of 3D Gaussians that treats Gaussians as volumetric primitives and ray marches them in a NeRF-like manner to achieve high quality at the cost of performance.
summary: RayGauss is a differentiable volume ray casting algorithm that generates photorealistic novel views using irregularly distributed anisotropic Gaussian primitives to minimize artifacts and adapt to scene geometry.
